title: Hair and scalp consultations in Cairo
description: Explore hair and scalp care in Cairo, including hair mesotherapy and growth factor options, when shedding needs investigation and how response is monitored.
h1: Hair and scalp consultations in Cairo
answer: Hair loss has several causes, and a scalp examination helps decide whether a procedure is appropriate. Adults can discuss hair mesotherapy, growth factor preparations and scalp care at {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin. The team reviews the pattern of thinning, symptoms and evidence for each option before suggesting a plan.
preparation: Bring a list of medicines and a history of when shedding started. Sudden, patchy or painful hair loss needs prompt diagnosis.
howPerformed: We examine the scalp, discuss whether investigations are needed and explain the proposed product and method before any treatment.
followup: Follow the washing instructions for your procedure. Compare the same areas over time and return if shedding or irritation accelerates.
risks: Injections can cause tenderness, bruising, allergy or infection. Product evidence varies and hair regrowth is uncertain.

faqs.a: Examination alone usually causes little discomfort. Scalp injections can sting.

faqs.q: How many visits might I need?
faqs.a: Review the response to the initial plan before booking further sessions.

faqs.q: Can I go back to my usual routine afterwards?
faqs.a: Follow the washing instructions for your procedure. Compare the same areas over time and return if shedding or irritation accelerates.

faqs.q: Can I have treatment if my skin marks easily?
faqs.a: A history of prolonged irritation or dark marks affects planning. Tell the team how your skin healed after previous procedures so the method and timing can be assessed.
